knowledge_gaps: The numerical gate lacks an operational pass/stop rule and a diagnostic time cap. An ordered top-10 change may only reorder existing members; report membership changes and the tenth–eleventh score gap separately.

Reproducibility still requires host implementation details: the actual baseline loss and candidate construction, empty-batch behavior, exact RNG keys including row, common epoch count, validation-query cap and remaining budget. Web searches cannot establish these local facts.

C−B estimates the effect of a training context policy, including changed recurrent computation and gradients. It does not isolate stale interests or stochastic regularization, and full-context inference introduces a training–inference context mismatch.

The report omits the earlier paired validation uncertainty plan and training-derived popularity/history-length audits. With 200 users per category, one changed hit shifts macro HR@10 by 0.125 percentage points; selecting the best condition also introduces selection bias.

Originality 4 and potential 7 are reasonable qualitative ratings. Difficulty 5 appears optimistic given precision localization, objective-specific masking and predictor consistency; 6 is more defensible. Keep cropping as the primary experiment and reserve learned decay for later evidence.

The supplied workflow description omits padding probes that appear in the reported metrics. Establish which diagnostic implementation and checkpoint produced each measurement. Explicit task restrictions override the generic metadata examples containing unavailable fields.
